title: Chicken Quesadilla
description: A simple and delicious Mexican dish, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner. Juicy chicken, gooey cheese, and crispy tortillas all come together in this classic recipe.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the chicken breasts with Mexican seasoning.
Cook the chicken in the skillet for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Shred the cooked chicken with two forks.
In a separate pan, warm the tortillas over medium heat for 30 seconds on each side.
Place a large spoonful of shredded chicken onto half of each tortilla.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over the chicken.
Fold the tortillas in half to enclose the filling.
Cook the quesadillas for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until the cheese is melted and the tortillas are crispy.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve with salsa, sour cream, and chopped cilantro if desired.
